data.long_meaning: Kacey is a modern name with no clear biblical or historical origin. However, its meaning is often interpreted as 'pure, free, and joyful'. In modern usage, it is typically given to girls. The name Kacey carries the meaning “Pure, Free, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kacey usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, free, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
